data.title: Working groups to draw up 'open government' plans
data.description: Four working groups will develop proposals on corruption, environmental problems, public participation and access to justice as Thailand works on its next national action plan for open government.

data.title: Debt trapping younger Thais
data.description: Young Thais are entering debt at increasingly early ages, gaining access to credit cards, instalment plans and digital financial services before many have developed the financial discipline to manage them.

data.title: City Hall to clean up Rom Klao estate 'in 4-5 days'
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has teamed up with the Defence Ministry to clean up Rom Klao Housing Estate in Lat Krabang district within four to five days as authorities step up drainage efforts in 80 communities still affected by flooding.

data.title: Govt defends  transfer of district chief
data.description: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee has defended the transfer of Ban Sang district chief Setthawut Wonglerwut, saying the decision was based on reports from provincial officials and local leaders rather than political pressure.

data.title: Govt begins paying out flood relief
data.description: Authorities on Thursday began transferring the first flood relief payments, as more than 1.42 million households have registered for assistance through the Tang Rat app, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) said.

data.title: Chinese suspect arrested at airport
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a 51-year-old Chinese man wanted in China for alleged illegal fundraising and fraud after intercepting him at Suvarnabhumi airport.

data.title: Abhisit urges probe into BMA project
data.description: Democrat leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged an investigation into the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration's cancellation of the Khu Bon retention pond project following land purchases by parties allegedly linked to City Hall.

data.title: Sri Lanka woos Thais ahead of 2027 expo
data.description: Sri Lanka is seeking Thai investment and business partnerships in sectors ranging from food and manufacturing to technology, tourism and healthcare as it prepares for Sri Lanka Expo 2027 in Colombo.

data.title: MRTA opens properties to investment
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to develop nearly 70 sites to generate more revenue and make better use of its land, with the first major project planned for the Rama IX area.

data.title: Meetings prompt WFH order
data.description: The government has ordered Bangkok-based state agencies to work from home on three days next week to ease traffic during the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group.

data.title: Dept revives coin tradition
data.description: The Treasury Department will launch a commemorative coin for the 2026 International Monetary Fund-World Bank Annual Meetings, reviving a tradition from the country's first hosting in 1991.

data.title: Anutin hit with no-confidence motion
data.description: Opposition parties have filed a no-confidence motion against Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 ministers, citing alleged Senate election collusion, exam fraud and administrative failures.

data.title: Ex-PTTEP executive in Rolls-Royce bribery case found in Indonesia
data.description: A former senior executive of PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP) wanted under an Interpol Red Notice in connection with a high-profile bribery case was arrested in Indonesia and is being returned to Thailand, according to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC)

data.title: Authorities search Jewish buildings in Bangkok
data.description: Authorities searched three buildings associated with Israelis in Bangkok on Thursday as part of an investigation into foreigners’ business activities in Thailand.

data.title: Thailand begins extradition process against Chinese journalist
data.description: Thai authorities began extradition proceedings on Thursday against a Chinese investigative reporter wanted by Beijing and detained for months in Thailand, his lawyer and an official told AFP.

data.title: Queen makes first solo flight in Gripen fighter jet
data.description: Her Majesty the Queen made her first solo flight in a Gripen fighter jet in Surat Thani on Thursday.

data.title: Worker killed in crane accident at Bangkok construction site
data.description: A construction worker was killed after becoming entangled in a crane cable on the roof of a hospital construction site in the Chaeng Watthana area of Bangkok on Thursday morning.

data.title: Drug-hunting police officers ‘take out the trash’
data.description: A truckload of police disguised themselves as Bangkok garbage collectors to enter a drug-trafficking hangout tucked deep into the back alleyways of Bangkok, leading to the arrest of a suspected drug kingpin with a long criminal record.

data.title: Philippines-bound ‘ice’ seized in Gulf of Thailand
data.description: Police have seized more than a tonne of crystal methamphetamine worth as much as 1.2 billion baht from a boat in the Gulf of Thailand that was reportedly carrying the drugs to the Philippines.

data.title: Thailand floats idea of B1,000 air departure tax
data.description: The Revenue Department is seeking public input on a draft law that would require travellers of all nationalities flying out of Thailand to pay a departure tax of 1,000 baht per trip.

data.title: South Korean gambling ring busted in Bangkok
data.description: Immigration police have busted a Korean online gambling operation in a luxury condominium in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok, arresting its alleged ringleader and nine other South Korean nationals.

data.title: Severe flooding persists in East as new storms loom
data.description: Severe and widespread flooding continues in eastern Thailand, with rainfall forecast to increase from late this week and move to the South, while Bangkok is mostly dry, the government said on Thursday.

data.title: Vegetable prices soar ahead of ‘J Festival’
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Vegetable prices at fresh markets in Phimai district of this northeastern province have risen sharply as heavy rainfall and flooding have damaged crops, with demand expected to increase ahead of the annual Vegetarian Festival.

data.title: Noisy teen bikers with fireworks rounded up in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police arrested 11 teenage motorcyclists for causing a public nuisance and illegal use of fireworks in Muang district of this island province early Thursday morning.

data.title: Bangkok faces submersion risk
data.description: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.

data.title: Chula launches new centre
data.description: Chulalongkorn University's Faculty of Engineering has launched a Water Resilience Centre to help Thailand prepare for extreme flooding under a "Black Swan" scenario in which multiple threats strike simultaneously.
